plan.notes: Source: 'BFA Performing Arts: Music Performance-Instrumental - Suggested Plan of Study 2025-2026 Catalog' (Dempsey College of Liberal and Performing Arts, Department of Performing Arts), official 2025-2026 SAU Undergraduate Catalog. *MUTH 1093 Fundamental of Music Theory is remedial (credit does not count toward the major requirements) and is omitted from the sequence. **MACP Class Piano I-IV sequenced at 1 credit each: the piano footnote states majors must take four hours of either piano or another instrument (fulfillable by proficiency exam), so piano is counted at the 1-credit printed value. 'Sophomore Barrier Required' (semesters 4) is a milestone, not a course, and is not sequenced. Upper-level Music electives across semesters 5-8 total 11 credits as required. Placeholder codes normalized: catalog 'MA__ 1003' etc. rendered as 'MA 1003' (primary-instrument applied instruction; instrument-specific prefixes MABS, MAPC, MACL, MASA, MAEU, MATP, MAFH, MATR, MAFL, MATU, MAOB, MAST); catalog 'MUEN_1__1'/'MUEN_3__1' rendered as 'MUEN 1X11'/'MUEN 3X11' (level-specific ensembles; see Major Ensemble Electives: MUEN 1101/3101, 1051/2051/3051, 1171/3171, 1071/3071, 1151/3151, 1081/3081). Choice slots use the first-listed option's code with choice=true. REPEATS (per SAU 2025-2026 Undergraduate Catalog): MUED 1000 Concert/Recital Attendance is required for 6 semesters ('All music majors except musical theatre majors are required to register for MUED 1000'); MUEN ensembles (1071/3071 Instrumental Ensemble, 1141/3141 Heritage Singers, 1061/3061 Chamber Singers, 3051 Marching Band) and applied instruction (MAVC Voice, MAGU Guitar) are sequenced every term per the catalog plans; allow_repeated_courses set 2026-10-01.
